facts.text: I am struggling to get the paint job right on my F-16 model.
I have been working on this project since February 10th.
I am building a 1/48 scale F-16.
I am aiming for a standard USAF scheme.
I am having trouble finding the right shades of gray for the paint scheme.
I have tried three different gray paints so far.
I have tried Vallejo Model Air acrylics.
I am considering trying Gunze Sangyo or AK Interactive.
I will probably try Gunze Sangyo's Mr. Color first.
I have heard that Gunze Sangyo's Mr. Color has good accuracy and blending capabilities.
I am deciding whether to get a specific gray set or individual bottles of the grays I need.
I will try getting individual bottles of the grays I need.
I plan to start with Mr. Color 308, 309, and 310.
I am thinking about starting my own YouTube channel or Instagram account focused on model building.
I want to share my own projects and tips with the community.
I want advice for a beginner like me.

starting a model building Instagram account
